about: [O6b] The havoc (brief O6b §3): ten cars parked along Grand Ave (?start=smash&beat=ten), rammed one after another by the keys a player presses (tools/lib/o6b_damage.mjs ram): E into my coupe; up the east kerb a diagonal from the lane under the el into each one's door (the last one twice), round the junction at Centre St, down the west kerb head-on into each one's tail; my car spent, E out, a walk to the next whole car, E in. Every car shows where it was hit: the ten states between them (dents, the bonnet sprung, a door hanging, a door off and lying, a bumper dragging, a bumper off, a wheel wobbling, a wheel off and the car on its hub, burning, the wreck); everything that came off lies still on the road, nothing floating, nothing in a wall. node tools/play.mjs tools/plays/o6b_ram.json

steps.label: ten cars rammed by the keys: the states of a car's damage between them, every part off at rest on the road, none floating or in a wall
